title: Pager non-temporary cache clearing

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerClearCache resets all cached database pages for non-temporary pagers while preserving the temporary-database cache required by its storage model.

external_source_responsibilities: Caller invokes only when B-tree cache clearing is eligible
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete temporary guard and cache retirement are assigned on the production Pager page-cache owner.

contracts.ownership: Non-temporary call consumes every Pager-owned cached page/data allocation; Pager retains empty cache capacity.
contracts.state_and_results: Temporary Pager is unchanged. Other pagers have zero cached and mapped pages afterward.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager synchronization. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible and leaves the Pager reusable.

representation_differences: The source delegates to pager_reset/PCache. The bounded Zig Pager explicitly frees its cached page/data owners and resets mapped_pages.

oracle.protocol: Populate a non-temporary Pager cache and clear it, then repeat with temporary=true and verify retained cache ownership.
oracle.normalization: Cache implementation details normalize to page identities and counts.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns Pager synchronization.
assurance.continuation: Pager remains reusable and pages may be fetched again.

integration.native_call_path: The helper retires the same CachedPage allocations used by getPage/lookupPage/unrefPage and WAL-change cache invalidation.

independent_review.notes: Requires temporary/non-temporary differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C cache-clear differential with temporary and non-temporary page identities.

implementation_spans: src/core/internal/pager_core.zig Pager cache ownership, WAL-change reset, get/lookup/unref, deinit, and tests were reviewed
callees: Explicit CachedPage data and owner destruction in Zig
assertions_branches_cleanup: Non-temporary call retires every cached allocation and clears mapped count
upstream_tests: Upstream pager, vacuum, temp, memdb, cache, and OOM tests exercise cache clearing
Project pager core/differential suites exercise cache ownership and WAL invalidation
